title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
blurb: Showed that a deep LSTM encoder and decoder can translate end to end, with source reversal and beam search as key tricks.
intro: One LSTM reads the source (reversed) into a fixed-size state; a second LSTM, initialised with that state, generates the translation one token at a time, and beam search picks the output. The steps build the LSTM cell, batching and teacher-forced training, and beam search; the capstone translates with the full pipeline.
